_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Batch S4 (Joolz/M&P/Mima). Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json. Single mode; joolz-geo2-double is the SAME stroller in double configuration.
name: Joolz Geo2 (Single / Mono Mode)

clekListed.clekRow: Joolz Geo2 (Single Mode) — Geo2 Upper car seat adapter (414001) — *lowest-position caveat

specs._weightNote: ~30 lb as single (US retailers); Strollberry lists 14.3 kg / 31.5 lb. Double config ~36 lb (see joolz-geo2-double).
specs._dimsNote: One-piece one-motion fold. 83 x 60 x 109 cm open; 42 x 60 x 99 cm folded (Strollberry).

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: from birth (converts with bassinet); seat 6 mo+

safety.standards: EN 1888 (Joolz). Clek's official list attests the model was tested to the applicable ASTM stroller/car-seat standard for Liing use.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible seat; 3-position recline incl. lie-flat; XXL 22-lb basket; 10-year transferable warranty. Clek notes a lowest-handle/lowest-seat-position caveat when a car seat is fitted.

specs.tires: 7 in front / 12 in rear (18 cm / 30 cm) EVA foam-coated wheels; all-wheel suspension

notes: Full-size single-to-double convertible; single/mono mode here. Heavier (~30 lb) — not the ultralight city goal but on Clek's list. Liing attaches via the Geo2 Upper adapter (adapter-414001), which explicitly lists Clek Liing/Liingo and is in stock at Joolz ($44.99). *Clek flags a lowest-position caveat with a car seat fitted. Max child weight: Joolz EU rates 15 kg (33 lb), US listings ~45 lb — recorded 45 with note.
